verdict.rationale: Elicit's pricing page lists 'API access' as a feature (elicit-docs-6), implying some programmatic access exists, but there is no evidence of actual public API documentation, endpoints, or specs—probes for OpenAPI/swagger files and doc pages all returned 404s (elicit-probe-2, elicit-probe-3). Missing for 10: published API reference/docs, authentication details, example requests, and any independent confirmation of developers using the API.
